intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Khao Yai. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Khao Yai stays are spread along Thanarat Road (the route up to the park). Stay in Pak Chong town for convenience, the train station and cheaper rooms; along the Thanarat Road strip for resorts, cafés, wineries and easy park access; or near the park entrance for quiet nature. You really want a car here.

faq.q: Which area of Khao Yai should I stay in?
faq.a: Most stay along Thanarat Road with its resorts, cafés and wineries near the park road. Without a car or on a budget, stay in Pak Chong town; for nature, choose near the park entrance.

faq.q: Do I need a car for Khao Yai?
faq.a: It is recommended — stays, cafés, wineries and the park are spread out with little public transport. Without a car, base in Pak Chong and use a tour or hire a car with driver for the park.

faq.q: When is the best time for Khao Yai?
faq.a: It is good year-round: the rainy season (Jun–Oct) is lush with full waterfalls, while the cool season (Nov–Feb) is pleasant for camping and cafés — and the busiest.
